siteDescription: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical writing guides, and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

adsense.note: Verification snippet live site-wide (2026-09-29). Ad UNITS remain unwired: nativeSlotId is empty. Keep Google-dashboard Auto ads OFF until approval. Ads must never resemble job cards or application buttons.

analytics.note: GA4 stream for thebryme.com, owner-supplied 2026-09-22. Injected into every page ahead of the AdSense loader by scripts/inject-analytics.py and emitted by the desk generators. Consent Mode v2 defaults are scoped to the EEA/UK/CH so visitors elsewhere are unaffected; Google's own CMP (AdSense > Privacy & messaging) sends the matching consent update once the owner enables it. Replaces the earlier published claim that these pages run no analytics.

affiliate.note: No affiliate links exist yet. Flip enabled=true only after provider accounts are live AND docs/revenue-rails.md placement rules have been applied. The disclosure note renders automatically on guides tagged 'affiliate: true' in front matter.

adsterra.note: LIVE: Adsterra Native Banner, bottom of page, on content pages only. Key and host taken from the owner's Adsterra snippet (2026-09-29). Native Banner ONLY -- the account's popunder/social-bar unit is refused by scripts/inject-ads.py because AdSense's site behavior policy bars pages carrying pop-ups, and the classic atOptions banner is declined because its invoke.js uses document.write. gateConsent: true (2026-09-30) -- the banner is loaded by /assets/adsterra-loader.js, which loads it immediately outside Europe and waits for granted ad consent inside the EEA, UK and Switzerland, because Google's Consent Mode only gates Google's own tags and Google's EU user consent policy requires consent to cover the publisher's partners too. The loader URL stays visible in page source as data-ad-src on the container. Set gateConsent to false to restore the plain inline tag; read that sentence again first. Set key/host back to empty to switch the band off.
